in_marathi.name: Parama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parama is a Sanskrit name that means supreme or ultimate. It is a name of reverence and respect, often used for divine or spiritual beings. The name Parama is derived from the Sanskrit word param, which means supreme or ultimate.
